errors.text_span: This pie chart visualizes the distribution of categories within the FineWeb-Edu Classifier clustering results.
errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that there are two pie charts, one for AttentionInfluence and one for FineWeb-Edu Classifier.
The chart (right side) actually comprises 17 slices.
The 'History & Society' slice on the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart is 19, but the description inaccurately lists it in orange on the left chart descriptions, mixing up charts.
The description fails to mention the comparison between AttentionInfluence and FineWeb-Edu Classifier as shown in the two charts.
